tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// grub chen dpal 'dzin pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo khros ma dmar mo lha gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ kro dhī bā ra hī badz+ra yo gi nī sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phag mo khros ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen dkyil 'khor dbus na nyid// gtso mo 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// stong nyid snying rje'i thig le mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal 'dud/ 1 oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sngags pas re zhig shin tu nyams dga'i gnas 'dug la/ lte dbus 'khor lo pad+ma dkar rgyas dri med steng*// bde chen 'byung gnas rab tu dmar ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom// de steng rgyal ba lha mo'i sa bon hrīḥyig blta/ 2 /me tog spos sogs sna tshogs mchod pa rab 'byams dang*// thub pa dges pa skye bo'i don sgrub chos kyi sgras// mkha' khyab byas nas slar 'dus yongs gyur 'bar ba yi// ye shes gri gug rdo rjes mtshan pa gsal por gyur/ 3 /de las slar yang 'phags tshogs mchod dang 'gro ba yi// don sgrub byas 'byung de nyid yongs gyur lha mo'i sku// dmar mo 'jigs khros phag zhal bgrad gdangs bgying bag brtan// gri gug thod 'dzin mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ 4 /de rjes de g.yas grags snyan sngon mo sgeg khros dang*// g.yon du rnam snang gser mdog gzhon nu ma rangs tshul// me long gzugs ltar rtse gcig bsams nas 'od zer gyi// lcags kyu rnon pos ye shes sems ma rab gzhug bya/ 5 /dus gsum rgyal bas shin tu byin brlabs dbang bskur ba// bde chen ye shes snying rje mchog gi ro myang zhing*// rnam dag mchod pas sngon du mchod la de nyid rjes// rdzas dang yid kyis sna tshogs mchod sprin rab 'byams spro/ 6 /mgrin pa lag pa lus kyi gnas rnams byin rlabs kyis// dag par byas pa rnal 'byor chen po'i nga rgyal can// dam tshig mchog rdzas chang gi mchod pa dang bcas la// de yis mnyes gyur snying gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma yi/

7 /sngags phreng gis bskor sems kyi hrīḥyig bye ru'i mdog /snying gi mun sel mkha' la nyi shar gsal ba ltar// brtse ba'i rlung bskyod ye shes 'od zer me 'bar bas// 'gro rnams kun gyi lus ngag yid kyi sdig bsregs nas/ 8 /slar 'ong 'od kyis rang nyid snying gi mun pa dag /de yis nyer bsregs dri ma ma lus rnam par bsal// mtha' dag snang tshogs rang sems dri med bdag nyid de// de bdag bdag nyid mkha' ltar spros bral rnam par dben/ 9 /de nyid 'dir ni bde chen khro mo'i skur bstan pa// zab mo'i spyod yul dpa' bo rnams kyis bsgom par bya// oṃ kro dhī bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī yai hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'bum phrag gcig dang gsum dang bzhi// lnga bzlas ma yengs yid can gyis// bgegs skrod grong khyer bsdu ba dang*// grong rdal 'jig dang don kun sgrub/ 10 /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro lha gsum gyi// rnal 'byor zab mo bla ma'i bka'// legs rnyed sngags sgrub sngags pa'i phyir// dpal 'dzin gyis byas mchog sgrub rgyu/ 11 /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phag mo khros ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bud+dha shrī dz+nyā na dang*/ bod kyi lo chung gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal la// btud nas 'jigs khros phag mo yi// sgrub thabs dpal 'dzin gzhung bzhin du// snying po las kyang snying por bri// skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lus ngag yid gsum dag par gyur/ lte bar pad+ma dkar po'i steng du chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du rang sems hrīḥyig gi 'phro 'du las/ gri gug hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/

slar 'dus pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo dmar mo phag zhal can shin tu khros pa/ g.yas su snyan grags ma sngon mo sgeg cing khros pa/ g.yon du rnam snang ma ser mo cung zad zhi ba/ de gnyis lha zhal can/ gsum ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis ro gdan gcig la bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// phaiṃ zhes ye shes pa spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+rīṃ bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ rigs bdag rgyas 'debs ni med do// ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs shing myang*/ bde chen dkyil 'khor dbus ma nyid// gtso bo 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// stong nyid snying rje'i thig le mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal bstod// snying gar pad+ma la sa bon sngags phreng gsal btab/ de las me 'bar bas sdig sgrib bsreg par bsams la/ oṃ kro dhī bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī yai hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas la mthar lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs la dge ba bsngo/ 'dir gtor chog ni/ thod pa'i nang du zlum gtor shas brgyan pa la chang blugs te/ thod pa khengs pa tsam bya/ bde mchog gi mngon rtogs gang rung zhig dang bstun nas byin gyis brlab/ phaiṃ zhes 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor mgron thams cad spyan drangs te/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags yongs rdzogs lan gsum gyis 'bul/ bya ba lhag ma yang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor nyid yin no// 'di'i rjes gnang byed na mdun bskyed mi dgos pas/ mngon rtogs tshar gcig blang*/ gtor ma gnyis bcas la gcig gtsang sar btang*/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge sogs kyi gsol btab dang*/

thugs kyi rjes gnang la/ lte ba la pad+ma 'dab gsum hrīḥ'abar ba dang bcas pa la sems gtad de/ rlung bzung du bcug pas/ de las gtum mo 'bar/ spyi bo'i thig le zhu bas bde stong bsgom du bcug gzhan mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i dmigs pa rnams bor nas rjes gnang spyi ltar dang*/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba'ang 'dra zhing*/ rjes chog ni mi dgos/ gtor ma gnyis pa de gtor chog gis btang ngo*// bud+dha shrī'i thugs dam gyi// lha rnams kun gyi snying po 'di// byams pa'i dpal la dga' bas gnang*// gzhung don tsam zhig snying por bris// bram ze dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u tshan no// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ 'di'i rjes gnang la/ mdun du zlum gtor sha chang gis brgyan pa gnyis dang*/ mchod pa bcas bsham/ slob dpon gyis skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas bdag bskyed dang*/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya/ gtor ma gcig gtsang sar rang bzhin gyis 'bul/ de nas slob ma mdun du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal 'dzin gyi man ngag bal yul mthil gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bud+dha shrī'i thugs dam/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal la bka' babs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo khros ma dmar mo gtso 'khor gsum ma'i rjes su gnang ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba grub/ khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs choms mdzod la// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod// lan gsum/ bla ma dang rje btsun phag mo khros ma dmar mo tha mi dad pa skyabs yul rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// lan gsum/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo khros ma dmar mo'i rjes gnang stsal du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ da rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dag par gyur pa'i lte bar pad+ma sogs nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur lam ste byung ba'i mos pa mdzod ces mngon rtogs ltar la/ rang nyid ces par khyed rang rnams zhes gyur/ rjes gnang dngos la gsum las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon la phag mo khros ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje phag mo khros ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ phaiṃ zhes pa'i sgra dang sngags kyi mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod cing spos rol bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon gyi snying gar pad+ma la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po/ de las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ slob dpon gyi kha sgo nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar pad+ma la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po la thim/

de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pas sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hrīḥyig la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig sngags gsum bzlar gzhug dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod cig bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma gsum pa hrīḥ'abar ba dang bcas pa la sems gtad de/ rlung bum pa can bzung bas/ de las gtum mo'i me 'bar/ spyi bo'i thig le zhu bas bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la rlung 'dzin du gzhug rjes dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams spyi ltar byas la slob ma gyes/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma gnyis pa de mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi tshogs btang*/ lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs la bsngo smon bkra shis sogs bya'o// zhes pa'ang mañju gho ṣas bris pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
